events.title: Arrival under a moving sky
events.description: A sudden shower caught Rowan outside the station with too much equipment and a route plan still folded shut.
events.authorNote: The first useful fact is fatigue. The uncertainty is what came next, not whether the rain happened.

events.title: Building the way through Afterlight Fields
events.description: Volunteer build day: painting wayfinding, dressing temporary barriers, marking important routes, and watering plants before the fictional festival opened.
events.authorNote: Clock times are deliberately absent. The day is certain; the sequence of small tasks is composite.

events.title: First shift, wet canvas, borrowed trust
events.description: A long opening shift gave way to a crowded camp and rain. Rowan left a camera tablet with Jules, a newly trusted volunteer at the badge-printing booth.
events.authorNote: Trust is the emotional fact. The person, device, role, and timing are fictional composites.

events.title: The same name on a different map
events.description: Rowan met another traveller also called Rowan after both reached for the same handmade zine and discovered an overlap in experimental radio and image-making.
events.authorNote: The coincidence deserves review because memory tends to make coincidence feel causal.

events.title: A route redrawn at the station
events.description: Instead of following the unopened plan, Rowan bought a train ticket toward Venice and let the intended destination fall out of the chapter.
events.authorNote: A confirmed decision, but not proof of what caused it.

events.title: Humidity and the last vaporetto
events.description: An uncertain evening window of humid streets, the last vaporetto, and a decision to leave Venice sooner than planned.
events.authorNote: Initial memory window only. The guided review narrows this to the late evening of 22 July.

events.title: Blue-hour contact sheet
events.description: A quieter coastal day became a contact sheet: photographs, music history, and unresolved route decisions reviewed beside the water.
events.authorNote: Stillness is recorded as a contrast, not as a conclusion.

events.title: Northbound before the birthday
events.description: Rowan boarded an overnight bus from Vienna to Berlin as a birthday approached, with the next chapter intentionally unresolved.
events.authorNote: The chapter ends at boarding. Arrival belongs to whatever follows.
